decision: Accept all eight exact feature responsibility signals; root owns registry integration
scanner: Reviewer reused canonical scanModule on exactly eight already-reviewed files to independently bind current function fingerprints; no application/test execution or full architecture gate

records.reason: Existing parent document editing and history presentation remain cohesive. Addition composes copied-tab links and excludes bound bodies from ordinary content projection; canonical copied-tab command lifecycle is separate. No new transport or authority owner.

Existing Workspace route/list/create container receives a single early delegation to BriefCopyRoute for exact copy query keys. Parsing, admission and command behavior remain in the new cohesive feature rather than expanding this route container.

Presentation of one copy lifecycle: recovery unavailable, retained command, existing editor, created receipt result, or explicit initial copy. It delegates body editing and all durable lifecycle behavior; this is one stateful workflow presentation responsibility.

One local complete-body editing surface switches between explicit JSON application and canonical section editing/preview. It owns draft-only presentation and mode errors; body admission and section replacement are separate pure functions. It owns neither API nor persistence. Rejected section identities are tracked within this same local body-admission responsibility until corrected or explicitly replaced via JSON.

One exact copied-tab draft form owns local name/body, source/current comparison, and explicit atomic-save input. Rendering delegates section/JSON editing and history; command execution and recovery remain in the hook. No parallel transport or legacy writes. Final display-only refinement keeps all five identifiers behind native details/summary and retains visible Core version; save input and lifecycle are unchanged.

One retained atomic command lifecycle coordinates canonical storage, serialized current journal observation, explicit submit/replay, receipt reconciliation and state-conflict retirement. These transitions share the same scope/lifetime/intent. DTOs, body semantics, receipt comparisons, network operations and storage implementation are separate canonical owners. The size signal remains visible; no generic transaction framework introduced.

Existing newsletter edit/undo/save lifecycle keeps its responsibility. The narrow delta excludes bound Core copies consistently from initialization, target selection and returned document identity. It neither implements copied-tab mutation nor projects bound rich bodies into legacy updates.

Existing saved brief/history/refresh view adds a delegated source-link presentation. Exact tuple construction lives in WorkspaceCopyLink; no Workspace transport, copy execution or durable state is added to this Portfolio viewer.

limits: Sparse-checkout aggregate blockers are not waived. This accepts these exact eight responsibilities only; no registry edits.
